description: This file contains the implementation of the Upgrade Wizard's layout management logic, including handling of module layout merging, rollback mechanisms, and display formatting for the SuiteCRM upgrade process.

methods.name: cleanMergeData
methods.description: Removes empty or blank layout data entries to prepare for confirmation display.

methods.name: rollBackMergedModules
methods.description: Restores previously merged module layout files from backup to revert changes.

methods.name: formatLayoutMergeDataForDisplay
methods.description: Prepares layout merge data for user interface display, tagging layout paths with labels.
